_note: Each field is {value, source, verify}. verify=false: copied from the cited FAO PDF in data/raw/fao/. verify=true: placeholder or outside publication that still needs checking. fao56_ch6.pdf page numbers are the printed page footers (n/32). fao66.pdf pages give the printed page number and the PDF page index. Temperatures in degC. season_start_month is 1 to 12. No winter chill fields in this version.
_planting_note: planting_months lists the months (1 to 12) in which a planting can start in the Central Valley; every annual has one and perennials have planting_months null (treated as year-round). season_days is the total days from planting to harvest, computed as the sum of that crop's stage_days. Both were added in iteration 2 for the optimizer. frost_tolerant (annuals only) says whether the crop handles frost in its first 45 days; the optimizer leaves out options for crops that are not frost tolerant when frost occurred within 45 days of planting in more than 20 percent of the backtest years (backend/frost.py).
